title: A game in the index, one file per game named after its slug

slug.description: The file's name without .json and the game's address on the site: the name in lowercase, every run of other characters than a-z and 0-9 turned into one hyphen.

name.description: The game's name as its creator writes it.

creator.description: The creator's handle on X, without the @.

creatorUrl.description: The creator's page, when it is not their X profile. Leave out to link to https://x.com/<creator>.

type.description: What the link leads to: play for the game itself in a browser, source for its repository, watch for a game that can only be seen in a video.

url.description: Where to play the game or read its source. Only a watch link may leave it out, and then leads to the post on X.

post.description: The id of the creator's post on X, the 18 to 20 digits at the end of its link, as a string: it is too large for a JSON number. The date shown for the game is read from it.

likes.description: Likes on the post when this entry was last updated.

model.description: The AI model the game was built with, as the creator names it, e.g. Claude Fable 5.2.

cover.description: The cover's file name, <slug>.webp, a 960x600 image in apps/web/public/covers.

summary.description: One line about the game for its card, in every site language.

pitch.description: A longer description, shown where the game is featured, in every site language.

time.description: How long it took to build, e.g. 8h.

prompts.description: How many prompts it took, e.g. 1.

size.description: The size of the game's files, e.g. 220 KB.

agents.description: How many agents built it, e.g. 25,000.

prompt.description: The prompt the game was made from, where the creator shared it.

notes.description: What the creator reported about building the game, each value as they wrote it. Shown as the game's build notes.
